newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cathay's Eddington to join Ansett - source.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cathay's Eddington to join Ansett - source.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd managing director Rod Eddington is to join Ansett Australia as its new chief executive, a source close Ansett said on Wednesday.
The source, who did not want to be identified, said Eddington would take up the position early next year. Contracts were still to be signed, the source said.
Earlier this year, the Sydney Morning Herald reported that Eddington was considering the position after significant changes to Cathay Pacific's share register.

Eddington, who was born in Australia, was understood to have been waiting for the completion of TNT Ltd's sale of its 50 percent Ansett stake to Air New Zealand before making a final decision on the position, the Herald said in May.
The Australian government gave final approval to the deal last week.
Eddington is due to arrive in Melbourne later on Wednesday and to take part in the Hong Kong government-organised business forum in Melbourne on Thursday.
An Ansett spokeswoman said she was unable to comment on the reports at this stage.
Ansett has been without a chief executive since the resignation of Graeme McMahon on March 13 after a major reorganisation of the airline's executive team.
Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd owns the remaining 50 percent of Ansett.
